description: This Java class configures email-related beans for a Spring application, including JavaMailSender, Thymeleaf template engine, and message source for email templates.

classes.name: EmailConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up email services, template engine, and message source.

methods.name: getJavaMailSender
methods.description: Creates and configures a JavaMailSender bean with SMTP properties.

methods.name: thymeleafTemplateEngine
methods.description: Creates a SpringTemplateEngine bean configured with a template resolver and message source.

methods.name: thymeleafClassLoaderTemplateResolver
methods.description: Creates a template resolver for loading email templates from classpath.

methods.name: emailMessageSource
methods.description: Creates a message source for email message localization.
